questions.question: What is the estimated total population of river dolphins in India as per the first-ever comprehensive survey?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**6,327**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s first-ever comprehensive river dolphin survey estimated presence of 6,327 river dolphins across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **first-ever comprehensive river dolphin survey** in India estimated a total of **6,327 river dolphins** across the country, with **635 dolphins** recorded in **Assam**.
 
• The river dolphin in Assam is called **Khihu**, and the survey was conducted under **Project Dolphin**.
 
• A **male Gangetic Dolphin** was **satellite tagged** in **Kulsi River near Guwahati**, marking a first in India and the world.
 
• **Assam’s Brahmaputra River** remains a stable and **barrier-free** habitat for river dolphins, while other rivers like the **Barak River** and **Subansiri River** show concerning signs of decline or extinction.
 
• The survey indicated that **Assam’s river systems** are critical for dolphin conservation, emphasizing the importance of **local community involvement** and the **protection of critical river habitats**.

questions.question: What is the name of the online vaccine management portal that PM Modi has launched in October 2024?

questions.question: As of October 2024, India is the home to _______ UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**43**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As of October 2024, India is home to **43 UNESCO World Heritage Sites**.
 
• India's World Heritage Sites include 35 cultural, 7 natural, and 1 mixed properties as recognized by UNESCO.
 
• The latest addition to India's list was the “Moidams: The Mound-Burial System of the Ahom Dynasty” from Assam, which was inscribed in July 2024.
 
• With this, India now has 43 sites on the World Heritage List and 62 more on UNESCO’s Tentative List.
 
• The UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India span a wide range of historical periods and cultural significance, from ancient monuments to modern marvels.
 
• India ranks sixth in the world in terms of the number of World Heritage Sites.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Sites**

 
 
• A UNESCO World Heritage Site is a landmark or area with legal protection by an international convention administered by the United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).
 
• These sites are designated as having cultural, historical, scientific, or other forms of significance.
 
• The program began with the Convention Concerning the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage, which was adopted by UNESCO in 1972.
 
• As of 2023, there are over 1,100 World Heritage Sites across the globe.
 
 
 
• **Criteria for Selection**
 
 
• To be selected, a World Heritage Site must be of outstanding universal value and meet at least one of ten selection criteria, such as representing a masterpiece of human creative genius or containing superlative natural phenomena.
 
• These criteria are regularly revised by the World Heritage Committee to reflect the evolution of the World Heritage concept itself.
 
 
 
• **India's Representation**
 
 
• India has a rich cultural and natural heritage, which is represented by its significant number of World Heritage Sites.
 
• The Taj Mahal, one of the most recognized monuments in the world, is a notable UNESCO World Heritage Site in India.
 
• Other significant sites include the Sun Temple at Konarak, the Group of Monuments at Hampi, and the Great Himalayan National Park.

questions.question: What is the headquarters location of Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), which has recently been granted Maharatna status?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is ​__**Bengaluru**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has been upgraded to 'Maharatna' status, announced by the Department of Public Enterprises on October 12, 2024, after approval from Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• HAL becomes the **14th Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) in India**, joining other notable PSUs like BHEL, BPCL, Coal India, GAIL, HPCL, Indian Oil, NTPC, ONGC, Power Grid, SAIL, Oil India, REC, and PFC.
 
• The upgradation is expected to enhance HAL's operational autonomy and financial powers, allowing for greater independence in decision-making.
 
• The proposal for HAL’s upgradation was previously recommended by two high-level committees: the Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC), led by the Finance Secretary, and the Apex Committee, chaired by the Cabinet Secretary.
 
• **For the financial year 2023-24, HAL reported an annual turnover of ₹28,162 crore and a net profit of ₹7,595 crore.**
 
• To qualify for Maharatna status, a CPSE must meet specific financial criteria: **an average turnover of over ₹25,000 crore**, an average net worth exceeding ₹15,000 crore, and an average net profit greater than ₹5,000 crore over the previous three years.
 
• Maharatna status provides significant operational autonomy, allowing PSUs to incur capital expenditures on new purchases or replacements without any monetary limit, and operate independently without relying on government guarantees.
 
• In comparison, Navratna status grants companies the ability to invest up to ₹1,000 crore or 15% of their net worth in a single project without prior government approval, but with more restrictions than Maharatna.

questions.question: Which region is set to become India’s next saffron hub after Jammu and Kashmir’s Pampore?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**North-east India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Centre plans to turn North-east into next saffron hub.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Jitendra Singh**, Union Minister of State for **Science and Technology**, emphasized the Northeast’s role in **India’s vision of Viksit Bharat** and its potential as the next **saffron hub**.
 
• The **Mission Saffron initiative**, launched in **2021**, has expanded **saffron cultivation** across **Sikkim, Arunachal Pradesh,** and **Meghalaya**.
 
• The foundation stone for the new permanent campus of **NECTAR (North East Centre for Technology Application and Reach)** was laid in **Shillong**.
 
• **Large-scale saffron cultivation** is already underway in **Menchukha (Arunachal Pradesh)** and **Yuksom (Sikkim)**, with plans to extend to **Nagaland and Manipur**.
 
• The initiative makes use of **uncultivated land**, boosting agricultural potential while maintaining existing crops, and aims to establish the **Northeast** as India’s **next saffron hub** after **Jammu and Kashmir’s Pampore**.

questions.question: Where is World’s largest titanium plant located?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Lucknow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World largest aerospace-grade titanium unit inaugurated in Lucknow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath opened India’s largest titanium and superalloy plant in Lucknow.

 
 
• 
 
The plant is run by **Aerolloy Technologies Ltd**, a part of **PTC Industries Ltd**.

 
 
• 
 
It covers **50 acres** and can produce **6,000 tonnes** of titanium every year.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **world’s largest single-site titanium remelting facility**.

 
 
• 
 
They also started work on new training and research centers.

 
 
• 
 
The **STrIDE Academy** will train people in **CNC, robotics, welding, and mechatronics**.

 
 
• 
 
A **Research and Development (R&D) Centre** will work on new alloys and better production methods.

 
 
• 
 
India will also work with **Trac Precision Solutions from the UK** to make special parts for jet engines.

questions.question: Which state in India is the first to offer a jungle safari through a Vistadome train?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Uttar Pradesh govt launches India's 1st Vistadome jungle safari train.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Uttar Pradesh** has launched a **Vistadome coach service** for jungle safari.

 
 
• 
 
It connects **Katarniaghat Wildlife Sanctuary (Bahraich)** with **Dudhwa Tiger Reserve (Pilibhit)**.

 
 
• 
 
UP is the **first state in India** to offer a jungle safari by Vistadome train.

 
 
• 
 
This is part of the **“One Destination, Three Forests”** plan by the state’s Eco Tourism Board.

 
 
• 
 
The Vistadome coach covers **107 km** inside the forest.

 
 
• 
 
It gives tourists a **close view of nature, wildlife, and biodiversity** during the ride.
